provenance.rationale: The English Word programme names Buenos Aires, a city tour and a tango show with dinner, combined in the source itinerary heading.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, enjoy a half-day sightseeing tour of Buenos Aires. See Plaza de Mayo, Café Torre Molinos, the Colón Theatre and Florida Street. The route passes through the historic San Telmo district, with its old buildings and flea market.

In the evening, enjoy a tango show with dinner at a traditional venue. After the show, return to the hotel.

blocks.text: Buenos Aires – El Calafate and Perito Moreno

provenance.rationale: The Word Day 6 itinerary includes departure from Buenos Aires, the flight to El Calafate and a Perito Moreno Glacier visit, condensed into a route heading.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, transfer with a driver to the airport. The flight to El Calafate in Santa Cruz Province is not included and is paid separately.

On arrival, discover the dramatic landscapes of Argentine Patagonia. Visit Los Glaciares National Park and Perito Moreno Glacier, a colossal mass of ice advancing into Lago Argentino. From the viewing platforms, admire the towering ice wall and hear its thunderous cracks as large chunks of ice occasionally break off and plunge into the water.

After the excursion, check in at your accommodation in El Calafate.
